EVIDENCE TO INSERT — Representative H&E colorectal tissue image
Insert an authorised, de-identified image used in this project, with dataset/sample identifier, source credit and known scale if available. This replaces the proposal's illustrative tissue image only if its provenance cannot be confirmed. Do not label a generated test pattern as histology.

EVIDENCE TO INSERT — Final Windows application overview
Capture the current committed application in a normal window, with readable input, result and session/export panels. Show commit/version evidence separately; redact personal paths. Use a real authorised input and identify the selected task/mode.

EVIDENCE TO INSERT — Real-weight single-image and tiled classification evidence
Provide two labelled panels from the same authorised raster image: Single image with probability chart, and Tiled analysis with mode summary, tile dimensions, nine-class legend and per-tile detail. Include image size, resize backend and model identity. Do not claim identical predictions between whole-image and crop-based modes.

EVIDENCE TO INSERT — Windows segmentation result and aligned comparison
Capture Overlay and Compare with original using the actual segmentation model. Include the full legend, pixel-coverage label, model/session identity and matched zoom percentages. Record source dimensions and segmentation tile/stride/input metadata.

EVIDENCE TO INSERT — History and recorded-parameter rerun
Show a real Single image row and Tiled analysis row, then restore the tiled record after changing current preferences. Capture its recorded model, mode, tile dimensions and backend. Show a separate new record after an intentional rerun.

EVIDENCE TO INSERT — Exported report and companion artifacts
Capture an opened PDF report plus the exported files in a folder. Ensure the report identifies the actual task/model/mode; show classification tile geometry/estimated coverage or segmentation parameters as appropriate. Remove identifying source paths before submission.

EVIDENCE TO INSERT — Cancellation and per-task model defaults on Windows
Capture a running tile operation, the Cancelling state and the unchanged previous completed record after acknowledgement. Separately show a validated local default and restoring that task's built-in default. This is a multi-panel evidence figure, not a claim of instant interruption.
